member.summary: Adds a message handler that resolves each request's authorization token from a fresh dependency-injection scope.
member.param: A delegate that resolves the authorization token from a per-request , the outgoing request, and a cancellation token. Returning null, empty, or whitespace omits the Authorization header for that request.
member.returns: The HTTP client builder for chaining.
member.remarks: pools message handlers for their configured lifetime, so a scoped token provider captured directly would bleed across requests. This registers a handler that creates a fresh per request, resolving from that scope's provider, so a scoped service (or ambient AsyncLocal state such as a host-registered IHttpContextAccessor) resolves correctly per request without any ASP.NET Core dependency.
